wages.text: His campaign says he is focused on raising the minimum wage and protecting the right to organize.
wages.quote: Greg is focused on investing in job training and small businesses, raising the minimum wage, and protecting the right to organize.

schools.text: His campaign says he will fight for increased public school funding and better teacher pay.
schools.quote: In Congress, Greg will continue to fight for increased public school funding and better teacher pay.

safety.text: His campaign describes efforts to add police resources, restore police overtime pay, and fund police recruitment.
safety.quote: He fought for additional resources for local police and fire departments, restored overtime pay for police officers, and funded a second police recruit class

guns.text: His campaign says he will support universal background checks, red flag laws, age restrictions, and an assault weapons ban.
guns.quote: In Congress, Greg will fight for universal background checks, red flag laws, age restrictions, and to ban assault weapons.

abortion.text: He says he is working to codify Roe v. Wade and protect access to reproductive health care.
abortion.quote: In Congress, Greg is working to codify Roe v. Wade, ensure access to birth control, and protect IVF treatment

energy.text: His campaign says climate change requires action and supports investments in renewable energy and sustainability.
energy.quote: We must take action to address the threat of climate change and pass down a sustainable, safe world to our children.

voting.text: He supports expanding ballot access and has backed voting rights legislation.
voting.quote: Greg supports expanding access to the ballot box and establishing independent redistricting nationwide so that voters choose their representatives, not the other way around.

debt.text: He says Social Security and Medicare benefits should not be cut or delayed.
debt.quote: Eric strongly opposes any effort to cut benefits or raise the retirement age.

safety.text: He supports funding, resources, and training for law enforcement and opposes cuts to police funding or authority.
safety.quote: He supports critical funding for law enforcement and equipping officers with the necessary resources and training to serve safely and effectively.

immigration.text: He supports increased border enforcement, physical barriers, and deporting violent immigrants who are in the country illegally.
immigration.quote: He supports comprehensive measures, including increased funding for border patrol agents, advanced surveillance technology, and completing physical barriers and the border wall where needed.

immigration.text: Weise supports easier entry into the United States, a path to permanent residency, and abolishing ICE.
immigration.quote: Nathan supports an Ellis Island-style immigration policy that makes entry into the United States easier and provides a simple path to permanent residency.
